name: Search iPhone by partial model query and open details
description: Verifies a short query like 16 pro max finds the iPhone 16 Pro Max card and opens its product details.
steps: Enter 16 pro max in the main search field
Verify Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max 256GB is the matching product and its product photo is visible
Press Подробнее on the iPhone card
expected: The iPhone 16 Pro Max product is found without requiring the full title, renders as a photo-based card, and its detail view opens.

name: Search Samsung with shorthand alias
description: Verifies shorthand model searches resolve to the intended Samsung product and the card remains usable if a remote image cannot load.
steps: Enter s25 ultra in the main search field
Verify Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 256GB is shown
expected: The Samsung S25 Ultra result is shown with its product photo when available, with a visible fallback area if the remote photo fails.

name: Enable alert and use alerts quick view
description: Verifies a user can enable a price alert, see its counter, and filter the catalog to alerted products.
steps: Open details for Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 256GB and enable the price alert
Close the detail view and press the bell counter in the header
expected: The alert counter reflects the saved alert, only alerted products are shown in the quick view, and the alert remains saved after refresh.

name: Filter and enforce comparison limit
description: Verifies catalog filters work and comparison rejects more than three products.
steps: Reset the search, select Samsung.lv and lower the maximum price, then reset the filters
Add three different products to comparison
Try to add a fourth product
expected: Filters narrow and restore the catalog, comparison remains at 3/3, and a visible maximum-three message appears for the fourth product.

name: Switch language and use photo product details on mobile
description: Verifies photo-based product cards and details remain usable on a phone-sized viewport.
steps: Tap LV in the language switch
Search 16 pro max and open the product with Vairāk
Review and close the product detail sheet
expected: The interface is in Latvian, the iPhone card and detail photo fit the mobile layout without horizontal overflow, and the detail sheet can be closed.
